text: What defined the 2014 parliamentary election? It took place amid boycott, severe contestation, and legitimacy debate over participation and competitiveness.
Why was the election controversial? Disagreement over election-time governance and opposition participation raised questions about representativeness.
How did 2014 affect political institutions? It intensified polarization and shifted the balance between electoral procedure and power consolidation.
Why does 2014 matter for current politics? It remains a key reference in debates over election credibility and democratic inclusion.
2014 made election legitimacy itself the central political battleground.
